title: Defence procurement velocity / distortion cluster — four-point pattern file
analyst: TENET5 investigation desk (Grok + local corpus) — Claude publishes
legal_standard: FACT cites primary government pages or named on-record spokespeople. REPORTING is secondary journalism. INFERENCE is analytical hypothesis only — not a court finding.

thesis.short: Canada's defence-procurement surface is showing two complementary distortion modes: (1) acceleration / sole-source signals on new capability buys, and (2) pause/pivot on a capped life-extension that may convert into a multibillion replacement path. Together they form a velocity/distortion cluster rather than four isolated stories.
thesis.investigative_core: Not whether helicopters need upgrades — whether public options analysis, contract numbers, spent-to-date, and authority chains keep pace with political defence-spending rhetoric.

primary_facts.claim: Official GLLE aims to extend 85 CH-146 Griffons to at least 2031; definition up to $90M; implementation up to $800M CAD.
Official schedule still listed: contract award 2022 · IOC 2024 · FOC 2027 · close-out 2028; page banner still 'Phase 3: Definition' as of 2026-07-11 re-check.
primary_facts.investigative_note: PRIMARY PAGE STALE: no mention of June 2026 pause on the official project page at re-check.

primary_facts.claim: June 2026: federal government orders life-extension work paused; Bell notified; talks with DND and PSPC on scope of ~$800M upgrade.
DND (Laura McIntyre-Grills via CBC): pause 'to allow for a reassessment of scope in light of cost, schedule, evolving complexity and planning underway for a replacement fleet.'

policy_backdrop.claim: Carney-era public defence spending target rhetoric (4% of GDP class by end of decade).
policy_backdrop.investigative_link: If spending rhetoric rises while options analysis and primary project pages lag, the public record gap itself is the story.

contract_timeline_partial.pattern_read: INFERENCE: definition (2019) → implementation award class (2022) → supplier chain + first flight (2023–24) → pause + replacement framing (2026) while official DND project page still frozen at 2020 definition schedule. Dual cashflow risk: ISS sustainment may continue while upgrade path freezes.

primary_source_freeze_2026_07_11.implication: INFERENCE: either the pause has not been reflected on the public project page, or the project remains formally in definition while media describes implementation-scope talks — both are accountability gaps requiring PSPC contract search + ATIP.
